questions.title: Competitive PGM English 41
questions.statement: Read the text and identify the most accurate conclusion. The situation combines adaptation, communication, academic responsibility, and decision-making during an exchange experience.

options.label: A
options.text: Successful exchange experiences depend on understanding information and making responsible decisions.

options.label: B
options.text: Exchange students should avoid communication whenever possible.

options.label: C
options.text: Rules and schedules are irrelevant during an exchange.

options.label: D
options.text: Academic responsibilities do not matter abroad.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A because exchange success depends on communication, adaptation, responsibility, and understanding information in different contexts. Option B contradicts the importance of communication. Option C ignores the role of rules and schedules. Option D is incorrect because academic participation remains important throughout the exchange experience.
